dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 10, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
"POWER SHOWCASE: Home Run Heroes Steal the Spotlight"

In a day filled with impressive performances, several players made their mark with big hits and dominating pitching. On the mound, Hunter Greene stood out with a complete-game shutout, striking out 12 in a 4-0 win for the Cincinnati Reds over the Chicago Cubs. Meanwhile, in the American League, Sean Burke was nearly unhittable, allowing just four hits while striking out nine in a 14-1 rout for the Chicago White Sox over the Oakland Athletics.

In the batter's box, several players showed off their power. Jake Burger hit a two-run homer in the Texas Rangers' 7-3 win over the Houston Astros, while Esmerlyn Valdez crushed two home runs, including a grand slam, in the Pittsburgh Pirates' 7-6 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers. Rafael Devers also hit a two-run homer in the Colorado Rockies' 4-3 win over the San Francisco Giants.
